description: Unit test class for EmployeeAttachmentDao in OrangeHRM, testing CRUD operations and behaviors related to employee attachments within the HR system.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentDaoTest
classes.description: Test suite for EmployeeAttachmentDao managing employee attachments, verifying save, retrieve, and delete functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up DAO instance, and populates fixture data.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Verifies saving a new employee attachment and its correct retrieval.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentForFreshEmployee
methods.description: Tests saving attachments for a new employee with specific employee number.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeAttachmentWithId
methods.description: Checks saving an attachment with a predefined attachment ID.

methods.name: testEmployeeAttachmentWithInvalidScreen
methods.description: Ensures setting an invalid screen value throws an InvalidArgumentException.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of attachments for an employee across different screens.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific employee attachment by employee ID, attachment ID, and screen.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeAttachmentWithoutScreen
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment without specifying the screen parameter.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Verifies batch deletion of employee attachments by IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeAttachmentsWithWrongIdForScreen
methods.description: Checks deletion behavior when IDs do not correspond correctly to specific screens.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Sets up a mock DateTimeHelperService to control current date/time during tests.
